title: Guidelines for Early Childhood Educators on Outdoor Learning
what_it_is: Guidelines for Early Childhood Educators on Outdoor Learning

sections.label: Outdoor learning in curriculum
sections.summary: National curriculum frameworks require all preschools to include outdoor learning in their curriculum.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Our national curriculum frameworks require all preschools to incorporate outdoor learning as part of their curriculum.

sections.label: ECDA guide not mandated
sections.summary: ECDA did not mandate preschools to implement the guide's recommendations or track implementation, as it was a resource for educators.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As the guide was meant to be a resource for educators, the Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) did not mandate the preschools to implement its recommendations nor track its implementation.

sections.label: Educators in training courses
sections.summary: Nearly 2,500 educators and centre leaders have participated in training courses and peer sharing sessions to date.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Nearly 2,500 educators and centre leaders have participated in the training courses and peer sharing sessions to date.

sections.label: Outdoor access in BTO preschools
sections.summary: Since 2017, ECDA has updated design specifications so new preschools in HDB BTO estates have direct and safe outdoor access.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Since 2017, ECDA has updated design specifications to ensure new preschools prebuilt in Housing and Development Board (HDB) Build-To-Order (BTO) estates have direct and safe access to outdoor spaces.

sections.label: Parent engagement and outdoor spaces
sections.summary: Preschools engage parents through outdoor activity pictures and regular meetings, and ECDA will work with MND, Town Councils and RNs on natural playgrounds.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For many Members in Parliament today who have young children, you may have come across pictures that your preschool send you with the children having activities outdoors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, that is one way in which the preschools actively engage parents to let their parents know what the children are doing outdoors and to also assure the parents that safety considerations and many other forms of protective measures are being undertaken to help and support their children.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There are also regular meetings between teachers and parents, so that the parents know what is happening in the preschool and also to be updated on the curriculum and what is the developmental guidance that the teachers are providing and have been sharing with the parents, so that parents are kept up-to-date and can work with the teachers on this learning journey for their children.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the second part of your question, indeed, we are always happy to work with MND.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I would just like to add that when it comes to incorporating natural gardens, community gardens, we will need to work with our Town Councils and we will need to work with Residents' Networks (RNs), especially when the estate is already built up and the preschools are already in the community.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I have mentioned in my reply that when it comes to pre-built facilities, ECDA will work with MND to make sure that there is a safe access to play areas.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But where the preschools are already in a community, then we will have to work with the Town Councils as well as the RNs, to see what could be incorporated into existing infrastructure, to create those natural playgrounds for children.
